segment.source: You are not signed in. Progress will not be tracked. Practice recommendations and personalized exercises are not possible.
You seem to have lost your internet connection. Some functionalities will not be available until you are back online.

source.pc: The page could not be loaded/displayed properly. We recommend you try the following.

pc.pc: Refresh the page (F5). Maybe your connection briefly flaked.
Make sure the URL is correct. No typos?
Try a hard refresh (Shift+F5) to ensure you don't have an old version of the web-app still cached on your device.
The above attempts all fail? It's probably us. Try again later.

source.pc: Is the bug still present later on? Then please send an email to (Hildo). I'll fix the bug, so that both you and others won't continue running into it. If possible, also add:

pc.pc: Where the bug occurred: for instance which skill/exercise.
What you did right before the bug appeared.
Possibly a screenshot of any red error message in the Developer's Tools console (F12).
